name: SFP Tech Holdings Berhad
summary: SFP Tech Holdings Berhad operates as an investment holding company, providing specialized engineering support services across Malaysia and to international clients. The firm organizes its operations into two main segments: Engineering Supporting Services and Automation. Under its Engineering Supporting Services umbrella, SFP Tech offers a comprehensive range of solutions. These include advanced sheet metal fabrication techniques such as cutting, bending, welding, deburring, and precision mirror polishing. They also perform intricate CNC machining and tooling services, covering milling, turning, surface grinding, electrical discharge machining (EDM), and CNC wire cutting. Furthermore, the company provides mechanical assembly services, ranging from integrating sub-modules to completing full product assemblies. The Automation segment is dedicated to the design, assembly, and commissioning of custom automation equipment and production line systems. This division also undertakes contract manufacturing for various types of equipment and machinery. Beyond these core activities, SFP Tech Holdings Berhad is involved in the trade of spare parts. Its diverse clientele primarily includes the semiconductor, electrical and electronic (E&E), and solar photovoltaic (PV) industries, as well as other sectors. Established in 2012, SFP Tech Holdings Berhad maintains its headquarters in Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia.
